title: The positioned layout draws circles as rectangles
foundBy: session agent, answering the repository owner's question whether a consuming page's protocol marks should be dots
details: In the positioned layout every shape draws as a rectangle of the mark's width, hollow or filled. A consuming page's legend shows the orchestrator's log claims as circles, to keep them apart from the channel's squares, and the timeline never drew a circle. A circle with room for the mark size should draw round; a hairline cannot.
